youtube_description: Mark Skaife is fuming after the red flag had been called out during qualifying that had cars stopped in pitlane. Jamie Whincup's rival Mark Winterbottom lets him proceed with only 2mins left on the clock to make the quickest time possible for race 10 of the V8 Supercars Championship in Perth.
